headline: 2 injured as crude bomb blasts hit Dhaka in multiple locations
summary: Explosions occurred under the Babubazar Bridge, in Moghbazar, Rampura, and New Market on Thursday evening.
details: At least two people were injured in a crude bomb explosion under the Babubazar Bridge in Dhaka on Thursday evening.
The injured, identified as Mosharraf Hossain (42) and Abdur Rashid (38), are both from Louhajang, Munshiganj.
Similar explosions were reported in other parts of the capital, including the Moghbazar intersection and the road opposite BTV Bhaban in Rampura.
Another blast occurred in front of Dhaka College in the New Market area late last night.
Police reports indicate that no injuries were reported in the Moghbazar, Rampura, and New Market incidents.
Authorities are currently investigating the exact timing and the number of explosive devices used in the New Market blast.
caption:
Multiple crude bomb blasts rocked Dhaka on Thursday evening, leaving two people injured.

Similar explosions were reported in other parts of the capital, including the Moghbazar intersection and the road opposite BTV Bhaban in Rampura.

Another blast occurred in front of Dhaka College in the New Market area late last night.

Police reports indicate that no injuries were reported in the Moghbazar, Rampura, and New Market incidents.

Authorities are currently investigating the exact timing and the number of explosive devices used in the New Market blast.

headline_marked: Bus burned, crude bombs explode in [[four Dhaka areas]]
headline: Bus burned, crude bombs explode in four Dhaka areas
summary: At least one person was injured as miscreants targeted multiple locations in the capital on Friday night.
details: At least one person was injured after several crude bombs exploded near Jatrabari Police Station on Friday evening.
In separate incidents, miscreants detonated three crude bombs thrown from flyovers in the Malibagh and Mohakhali areas of Dhaka.
A parked bus was also set on fire in front of the Kafrul Police Station around 10:00 PM on the same night.
Sub-Inspector Zahirul Islam, the duty officer of Kafrul Police Station, confirmed the arson attack but stated there were no casualties in that specific incident.
The police have not yet identified the bus company involved in the fire.
caption:
Crude bombs and arson in the capital: multiple areas of Dhaka targeted in a series of attacks.

At least one person was injured after several crude bombs exploded near Jatrabari Police Station on Friday evening.

In separate incidents, miscreants detonated three crude bombs thrown from flyovers in the Malibagh and Mohakhali areas of Dhaka.

A parked bus was also set on fire in front of the Kafrul Police Station around 10:00 PM on the same night.

Sub-Inspector Zahirul Islam, the duty officer of Kafrul Police Station, confirmed the arson attack but stated there were no casualties in that specific incident.

The police have not yet identified the bus company involved in the fire.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star
